read: the close fell 9.98% from saturday 26 september to saturday 3 october and still sits 17.88% above the 50 week average, the 3rd close above that line in a row and in the 48 weeks it exists in our series, which starts on 19 november 2024. a week earlier the gap was 30.41%. the block reward fell to 2.0602 kas on monday 5 october, 5.61% below the 2.1827 of saturday. hashrate averaged 343.92 PH/s from 27 september to 3 october, against 342.72 the week before.
